desc: Derive the precise reversed transition \((x,y)\to(u,v)\) using matching labels on \(u\to x\) and \(y\to v\).
Design an efficient multi-source shortest-path implementation over the \(N^2\) product states.
Determine practical transition enumeration/grouping by character within the constraints.
Prove handling of repeated vertices, self-loops, and unreachable pairs.
Implement input parsing and output formatting.
Run both samples and targeted edge-case tests, then correct any failures.
